<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def st():
    f=current_frame; bs={}; pal={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['pixels']>=16 and n['color'] in 'MRNb':
            if min(rs)<50: bs[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
            else: pal[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs))
    lines=f.ascii.splitlines(); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(12,42) for c in range(17,47) if lines[r][c] in 'wg']
    bs['beam']=(min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    return bs,pal

print('start:',st())
r=action(['LEFT']); print('after LEFT:',st(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done')})
r=action(['ACTION7']); print('after ACTION7(R@18-21):',st(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def st():
    f=current_frame; bs={}; pal={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['pixels']>=16 and n['color'] in 'MRNb':
            if min(rs)<50: bs[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
            else: pal[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs))
    lines=f.ascii.splitlines(); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(12,42) for c in range(17,47) if lines[r][c] in 'wg']
    bs['beam']=(min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    return bs,pal

print('start:',st())
r=action(['LEFT']); print('after LEFT:',st(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done')})
r=action(['ACTION7']); print('after ACTION7(R@18-21):',st(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
